name: City Council Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, October 25, 2023 - 6:30 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
 This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model. Members of the public may join this meeting
 virtually or attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81274023542
  Webinar ID: 812 7402 3542
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,81274023542# OR +16699009128,,81274023542#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 346 248 7799

 Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor or
 the meeting chairperson. The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to
 speak must “raise their hand”, at which time they will be unmuted.

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
 distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
 hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
 Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Halpern, McSweeney, Honig, Mayor Pro
  Tem Davis, Mayor Pearl

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of October 11, 2023 City Council Closed Session and City Council Regular
Meetings

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

  1. Agoura High School Principal, Garrett Lepisto, Welcome and Introduction

  2. Business of the Quarter Recognition from the City and the Greater Conejo
  Valley Chamber of Commerce, 2023 4th Quarter, presented to Glass Arts
  Collective

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the printed
agenda. Please observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment
telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed on Page 1
of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior to
the meeting starting.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Chamber of Commerce Report

4.  Library Report
 CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE – KINDNESS AWARD CRITERIA - Adopt the
  Guidelines for the Annual Cecilia DePippo Kindness Award.

2.  CULTURAL RECREATION COMMITTEE – COMMUNITY PARK PICKLEBALL
  COURTS PROJECT —CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL OF CONSTRUCTION
  CONTRACT  AWARD,  DESIGN  SUPPORT  SERVICES  CONTRACT
  AMENDMENT, MEASURE A GRANT FUNDING APPLICATION, COMMUNITY
  BENEFIT FEE APPROPRIATION, AND CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2323-23 - Determine the Community Park Pickleball Courts
  Project is exempt from CEQA, adopt Resolution No. 2323-23 authorizing filing of
  an application for $271,798 of Measure A funds; appropriate $91,723 of Community
  Benefit Fee to this project; award a construction contract in the amount of $605,388
  to Pacific Tennis Courts Inc.; authorize the City Manager to approve construction
  change orders up to $60,400; approve Amendment No. 3 in the amount of $11,300
  to the Professional Services Agreement with RRM for construction support services;
  and authorize the Mayor to execute the contract documents on behalf of the City.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2323-23: RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING
  THE FILING OF AN APPLICATION FOR GRANT FUNDS FROM THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  REGIONAL PARK AND OPEN SPACE DISTRICT FOR MEASURE A FUNDING FOR THE
  COMMUNITY PARK PICKLEBALL COURTS PROJECT
  The Pickleball Plans can be accessed on the City's website at:
  https://www.wlv.org/DocumentCenter/View/4136/WLV---Pickleball-Bid-Plans-Final
PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION 9.14.050 OF CHAPTER
  9.14 AND SECTION 9.25.020 OF CHAPTER 9.25 OF ARTICLE 9 OF THE
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE PERTAINING TO REGULATIONS
  FOR FENCING, WALLS, AND GATES; ORDINANCE NO. 305-23 - Waive the full
  reading and introduce Ordinance No. 305-23 and schedule the second reading on
  November 8, 2023.

  ORDINANCE NO. 305-23: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AMENDING
  THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE TO UPDATE ARTICLE 9 ZONING REGULATIONS,
  CHAPTER 9.14, SECTIONS 9.14.050, AND CHAPTER 9.25 SECTION 9.25.020 AND APPROVING
  A CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report
 CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will be
no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the Consent
Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective October 15, 2023 in the amount
  of $461,124.87

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  ADOPTION OF ADMINISTRATIVE RULE NO. 2023-001 PERTAINING TO
  THE SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT ORDINANCE - Adopt Administrative
  Rule No. 2023-001 and find that the administrative rule is exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act.

  ADMINISTRATIVE RULE 2023-001: Occasional Construction and Demo Haulers are not
  required to collect fees pursuant to Westlake Village Municipal Code Section 5.3.150 or any
  associated City Council Resolutions (including Resolution Nos. 586 and 1438-08).

  2.  APPOINTMENT OF INTERIM CITY TREASURER; RESOLUTION NO.
  2324-23 - Adopt Resolution 2324-23, appointing Assistant City Manager
  Josephine Wilson as the Interim City Treasurer.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2324-23: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPOINTING JOSEPHINE WILSON AS INTERIM CITY
  TREASURER

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 23-003; RESOLUTION NO. 2325-23 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2325-23, approving Conditional Use Permit No. 23-003, determine it
  is exempt from CEQA and reauthorize the sale of beer, wine, and distilled spirits for
  onsite and offsite consumption in conjunction with the operation of a restaurant
  located at 30770 Russell Ranch Road Suite G.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2325-23: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 23-003 TO REAUTHORIZE
  THE SALE OF BEER, WINE, AND DISTILLED SPIRITS FOR ONSITE AND OFFSITE
  CONSUMPTION IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE OPERATION OF A RESTAURANT LOCATED AT
  30770 RUSSELL RANCH ROAD, SUITE G

2.  APPROVAL OF A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING USE OF SUMMARY CRIMINAL
  HISTORY INFORMATION FOR EMPLOYMENT PURPOSES AND CRIMINAL
  BACKGROUND CHECK POLICY; RESOLUTION NO. 2326-23 - Adopt Resolution
  No. 2326-23 authorizing use of State and local summary criminal history information
  pursuant to Penal Code sections 11105(b)(11) and 13300(b)(11) for employment
  related purposes; and, approve the Criminal Background Check Policy.
   RESOLUTION NO. 2326-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AUTHORIZING ACCESS TO CRIMINAL HISTORY INFORMATION
  FOR EMPLOYMENT PURPOSES AND SUBMISSION OF AN APPLICATION FOR SUCH ACCESS
  TO THE CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  APPROVAL OF PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH CIVIC
  SOLUTIONS, INC. FOR ON-CALL PLANNING SERVICES - Approve the
  Professional Services Agreement with Civic Solutions, Inc., authorize the Mayor to
  execute the agreement, and find that the agreement is exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, October 19, 2023 at 4:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall.
